item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E014","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E015","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt reported that from 2019 to June 2023 the Public Prosecutor held 29 anti-trafficking training courses for 577 staff, while the Interior Ministry held 55 related courses from January 2019 to March 2023 in coordination with several international organizations.","notes":["The excerpt dates the Interior Ministry courses through March 2023, not June 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E016","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E017","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Egypt reported that from January 2019 to June 2023 the Interior Ministry organized 47 human-rights training courses; the Public Prosecutor held 29 anti-trafficking courses for 577 staff and 16 human-rights courses attended by 257 trainees. The Ministry of Defence reported 22 human-rights courses in military colleges, without a period specified in the excerpt.","notes":["The excerpt does not establish that the 22 military-college courses occurred during January 2019 to June 2023."]}]}
